limitations: Shadow held-out rows are seen-task evaluation; shadow train rows are also used for fitting and weight selection.
Novel held-out rows are task-unseen evaluation; no novel rows are used for model fitting or weight selection.
A zero fitted exact_flag or open_gap weight makes that channel's corresponding ablation a null contrast for that seed/mode.
Author and beam use different budget units; cross-path work comparisons are descriptive and are not equal-budget claims.
All candidates are signature-evaluated before ranking; canonical signature work can remain invariant across ranking ablations.
The reachability/canonical comparison includes separate weight refinement per mode, so it is an end-to-end pipeline contrast.
Three seeds and these fixture families do not establish broad generalization or a causal claim about candidate generation.
Wall time is specific to the recorded runtime and host.

provenance.source_hash_method: SHA-256 over sorted repository-relative implementation paths and bytes; SpikeForge has a separate package-relative content hash; fixtures are hashed before and after
provenance.source_hash_scope: repository rsi_programmer Python files, measurement script, imported SpikeForge Python source bytes and fixture bytes

reachability_vs_canonical.interpretation: end-to-end retraining and weight-refinement comparison; weights are fit separately by supervision mode
